name: supreme-coding-guidelines
description: The .ah skill bundle for Claude Code. Cavalcante (originator of MAIC™, HIM™, and NHE™). Auto-discovers nine skills from the skills/ directory: ah-parser (one-time bootstrap of the .ah grammar with three-mode output protocol), supreme-coding-guidelines (always-on behavioral rules), supreme-project-audit (on-demand evidence-driven audit), supreme-problem-solving (on-demand analyze-verify-diagnose-solve workflow with structured tabular deliverable), supreme-ai-engineering (on-demand AI/ML/LLM/MLOps/LLMOps engineering discipline), supreme-npm-node (on-demand NPM/NPX/NPMJS/Node discipline with latest-version-always policy via ncu -u, TypeScript strict mode, OIDC provenance), supreme-content-craft (on-demand SEO/SEM/Header Binding/Copywriting/Marketing/Writing discipline with AIDA + Cialdini 6 principles + StoryBrand/PAS/FAB/Schwartz/SUCCESs/Ogilvy/Hopkins + Schopenhauer ethical eristic + Joe Girard Law of 250 + Cialdini Pre-Suasion, plus 15 quality tool gates), supreme-council (on-demand multi-perspective deliberation council with four cognitive personas — First-Principle Thinker, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor — running a three-round protocol of individual outputs, anonymous peer review, and synthesis that preserves dissent; integrates Spec-Kit phasing, Klein premortem, Cynefin uncertainty handling; never tries to please the user), and supreme-benchmarking (on-demand research-grade benchmarking for AI/ML/LLM/npm inspired by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, DeepSeek, Xiaomi MiMo, Hugging Face, and Unsloth methodologies — four personas applied to benchmark design, statistical rigor gates with CI95 and multi-seed variance, contamination defense with canaries, harness version pinning, tinybench/mitata/hyperfine/size-limit for npm, benchmark cards with bold-best tables and error bars, one-command reproducibility, honest disclosure of negative results, CI regression tracking). User code is always preserved verbatim regardless of output mode.
